entries.43be6b4aac578f5c: Its management philosophy is: “More days that move the heart. COX continues to provide essential richness that enhances our customers’ fashion and lifestyle.” For the fiscal year ending February 2027, the company has set “Deepening into a Beautiful Life Innovator (new lifestyle proposal company)” and aims for stable growth by continuing three priority measures: “expanding store sales,” “expanding EC sales” and “maintaining and improving gross margin.” In stores, it plans to improve sales per tsubo through expanded magazine tie-up planning and relocation to better locations, and to strengthen hiring and sales capabilities in customer service; in EC, it plans to strengthen OMO on its own EC site, renew its membership program, and advance WEB advertising on external malls. On the procurement side, it aims to maintain its cost ratio by promoting direct import and direct trade flows and narrowing its list of trading partners.
